output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balanceOf[target] is not checked for overflow, allowing it to be set to a very large value, in the case of a typo in the target address, it can be set to a very small value, causing a denial of service to the target.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balanceOf[_to] is not checked for overflow, allowing it to be set to a very large value, in the case of a typo in the _to address, it can be set to a very small value, causing a denial of service to the target.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balanceOf[_to] is not checked for overflow, allowing it to be set to a very large value, in the case of a typo in the _to address, it can be set to a very small value, causing a denial of service to the target.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The decrease in balanceOf[msg.sender] is not checked for underflow, allowing it to be set to a very small value, in the case of a typo in the target address, it can be set to a very large value, causing a denial of service to the target.
The mintToken function has a typo in it, allowing it to be called only once, in the target address, it can be set to a very small value, causing a denial of service to the target.
